Does the second-order phase space of the real-lift update supply a canonical J? Such a J must:
- commute with the cubic action;
- make the condensate J-linear or J-Hermitian;
- cover the null modes, or exclude them on independent grounds.

A complex structure that is mathematically available is not one derived from OI.
